Enrich site_scores with parameter metadata and rename studyid to study

BuildResults.Rd

Joins CTAS site_scores to timeseries on timeseries_id to recover parameter_id, and to the parameter metadata derived from dfInput to recover the category columns CTAS discards. Renames studyid to study (ctasapp vocabulary) when the multi-study contract is active.

Usage

BuildResults(lCTAS, dfInput, strStudyCol)
